author: Will Jones
description:
A summary of the most interesting stories in the past 24 hours that challenge the prevailing orthodoxy about the ‘climate emergency’, public health ‘crises’ and the supposed moral defects of Western civilisation.

The post News Round-Up appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: News Round-Up

author: Will Jones
description:
Sir Keir Starmer was a pioneer of groundbreaking legal cases that opened the floodgates for war crime claims against British troops in Iraq, according to his Attorney General Lord Hermer's own testimony.

The post Hermer Credited Starmer With Opening Floodgates for War Crime Claims Against British Soldiers appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Hermer Credited Starmer With Opening Floodgates for War Crime Claims Against British Soldiers

author: Will Jones
description:
Statements made by Essex Police said to be about Daily Telegraph journalist Allison Pearson in relation to a row over an X post could be defamatory, a High Court judge has ruled.

The post Police “May Have Defamed” Allison Pearson in Row Over X Post appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Police “May Have Defamed” Allison Pearson in Row Over X Post

author: Will Jones
description:
Confidential medical data belonging to half a million UK citizens has been breached from UK Biobank and put up for sale on a Chinese website, with the Government unable to guarantee individuals cannot be identified.

The post Genetic Data of Over 500,000 Volunteers Leaked in UK Biobank Breach appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Genetic Data of Over 500,000 Volunteers Leaked in UK Biobank Breach

author: Will Jones
description:
A choir has been dropped from the London Marathon over its founder's gender-critical views after organiser Scope said the views were contrary to its "commitment to diversity and inclusion".

The post Choir Dropped From London Marathon Over Founder’s “Gender-Critical Views” appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Choir Dropped From London Marathon Over Founder’s “Gender-Critical Views”

author: Mark Littlewood
description:
The latest revelations in the Mandelson vetting scandal show, obviously, that Starmer is finished. But, more importantly, they reveal that Britain's system of government is fundamentally broken, says Mark Littlewood.

The post Starmer is Finished. But, More Importantly, Britain’s System of Government is Fundamentally Broken appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Starmer is Finished. But, More Importantly, Britain’s System of Government is Fundamentally Broken

author: Steven Tucker
description:
